definitions.gloss: fever caused by illness; fever from disease
definitions.explanation: An elevated body temperature resulting from illness or disease. Distinguished from fever caused by external factors like heat exhaustion.

examples.japanese: {病熱|びょうねつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{寝込|ねこ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She is bedridden with fever from illness.

examples.japanese: {病熱|びょうねつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がら→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧ず、⟦{入院|にゅういん}する→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: The fever from the illness wouldn't go down, so hospitalization was decided.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{病熱|びょうねつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しみ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{原稿|げんこう}→原稿：00064_genkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{続|つづ}けた→書き続ける：29433_kakitsuzukeru⟧。
examples.english: Despite suffering from fever, he continued writing his manuscript to the very end.

notes:
Composed of {病|びょう} (illness, disease) and ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧ (heat, fever). A literary word more commonly found in novels and historical writing than in everyday conversation.

In everyday speech, simply ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧ (fever) or ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have a fever) is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {病熱|びょうねつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧ (to suffer from fever)
- {病熱|びょうねつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧ (to collapse from fever)
- {病熱|びょうねつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (fever persists)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {病熱|びょうねつ}: fever caused by illness (literary)
- ⟦{発熱|はつねつ}→発熱：06297_hatsunetsu⟧: developing a fever (medical, clinical)
- ⟦{高熱|こうねつ}→高熱：14649_kounetsu⟧: high fever (describes severity)
